definitions.explanation: Indicates something that happens regularly every night or evening.

examples.japanese: {毎晩|まいばん}{本|ほん}を{読|よ}みます。
{毎晩|まいばん}{十一時|じゅういちじ}に{寝|ね}ます。
examples.english: I go to bed at eleven o'clock every night.

examples.japanese: {毎晩|まいばん}お{風呂|ふろ}に{入|はい}ってから{寝|ね}ます。
examples.english: I take a bath every night before going to bed.

examples.japanese: {毎晩|まいばん}{家族|かぞく}と{一緒|いっしょ}に{晩|ばん}ごはんを{食|た}べて、テレビを{見|み}ます。
examples.english: Every evening, I eat dinner with my family and watch TV.

examples.japanese: {毎晩|まいばん}{寝|ね}る{前|まえ}に{本|ほん}を{読|よ}んだり、{音楽|おんがく}を{聞|き}いたりして、ゆっくり{休|やす}みます。
examples.english: Every night before bed, I read a book, listen to music, and relax.

notes:
{毎晩|まいばん} means every night/evening, typically the time after dinner until bedtime.

WORD FORMATION:
{毎|まい} (every) + {晩|ばん} (evening/night)

RELATED {毎|まい} WORDS:
- {毎朝|まいあさ}: every morning
- {毎日|まいにち}: every day
- {毎週|まいしゅう}: every week
- {毎月|まいつき}: every month
- {毎年|まいとし/まいねん}: every year

USAGE:
Like other {毎|まい} words, often used adverbially without particles:
- {毎晩|まいばん}{本|ほん}を{読|よ}む (I read books every night)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {毎夜|まいよ}: every night (more literary)
- {夜|よる}ごとに: every night, nightly
